Yet what is known about the LSU is only a few isolated mechanisms and parameters, and even a…

items.excerpt: Safety benchmarks for computer-use agents (CUAs) place the harm either in the intent of the task or on a single screen: a malicious instruction, an injected command, a phishing page. An agent that checks the task and each screen in isolation can pass them, so they do not test whether it combines…
